name: Aibou DS
source:
Visual novel adaptation of the hit drama AIBOU: Tokyo Detective Duo.

The drama features Ukyō Sugishita, a police inspector assigned to the fictional Special Missions Unit of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department and his partners.
